description:
From the fz-kdt.120 research (2026-09-02, d2a5f3510). `t.is_subtype(&empty, &list_int)`
is true, yet `t.display_for_diag(&t.union(empty, list_int))` is "[] | [int]": the
DNF clause list keeps a clause another clause subsumes. Ty identity drives change
detection and activation keys, so two identity-distinct, semantically equal types
can key two executables and two return-evidence revisions. fz-kdt.120's rule makes
this visible (`reduce` at a ground reducer answers Known { result: [] | [int] }).
Related: fz-kdt.48 differently-carved twins, fz-f98.21's widening cure (sorting at
intern removed ORDER dependence, not subsumption). Direction: subsumption-normalise
at intern (drop a clause contained in a sibling) where the containment is decidable
by Types itself; measure the executable inventory delta and confluence.

comments.text: CLOSED AS DUPLICATE of fz-kdt.48 (2026-09-03); the measurements are recorded there.

REOPENED (2026-09-03): the fz-tfn epic sequences this explicitly ('fz-kdt.182 then fz-kdt.48 establish one Ty per denotation'), so it is the concrete first step of 48 (empty-list union subsumption at intern), not a duplicate to close. The closing comment's measurements stand; keep parent fz-tfn.

RESIDUE FROM fz-kdt.183 (rule review, 2026-09-03), owned here by this ticket's own title: (1) the empty-rung census 53/15 -> 58/16 under the rule -- four honest code-different specializations on demanded slots (Map.reverse/2 [empty_list(), ..] compiles clause 0 only; Range.reverse/2; Map.to_list/4 slot 3 and Range.slice_from/5 slot 4 by forwarding) and two on non-recursive dbg/1 / fz_dbg_value/1 keys; the rung generator is list_element_type([]) = none, i.e. empty_list() never converging with list(τ) -- exactly this ticket's union normalisation (`[] | [int]` vs `[int]`). (2) Same-key DUPLICATE executables in one BackendProgram: base 67 extra (key, need) rows over 15 fixtures, 31 byte-identical modulo executable ids (00531: List.delete_first/2[list(int), int] twice, 0 diff lines); the rule amplifies it to 73 / 39 / 17. Bears on fz-f98.21's byte-identical BackendProgram. Both numbers are ratchets to drive down here.

title: Types::union(empty_list(), list(int)) interns as "[] | [int]": unions are not normalised by subsumption, so identity-distinct equal types mint duplicate executables
